paywallet.title: Payments wallet
paywallet.description: A wallet just for paying on Kiba. Your assistant pays for services from it without asking you every time.
paywallet.point_dedicated: It is a separate wallet: it does not mix with your other wallets. You put in what you want to spend.
paywallet.point_free_spend: Your assistant pays from it without asking you to sign each payment.
paywallet.point_yours: It is yours: Kiba can only charge your usage; you decide when to top up, withdraw or revoke.
paywallet.point_no_xlm: You do not need XLM: Kiba pays the network fees.
paywallet.create_hint: You will sign in with your email (Privy sends you a code) and sign once. It takes about 30 seconds.
paywallet.use_external: I would rather use my own wallet (Freighter, xBull, Lobstr…)
paywallet.capped: Your permission has a limit: Kiba can charge up to {{amount}} USDC more.
paywallet.blocked_hint: We could not charge {{amount}} USDC of usage. Top up the wallet to keep using services.
paywallet.inactive_hint: The permission was revoked or expired: your assistant cannot pay from this wallet until you activate it.
paywallet.expiring_hint: Your permission expires soon. Renew it so your assistant can keep paying.
paywallet.legacy_hint: You have {{amount}} USDC in your previous wallet, which Kiba controls. Move it to your payments wallet, which you control.
paywallet.legacy_move: Move {{amount}} USDC to my payments wallet
paywallet.revoke_confirm: Sure? Your assistant will no longer be able to pay.
paywallet.topup_hint: Send USDC (Stellar network) to this address from any wallet or exchange:

paywallet.withdraw_hint: Send your balance to another wallet of yours. You can withdraw up to {{amount}} USDC.
